description: A local-first workflow assistant for triage learning, Waiting follow-ups, reschedule history, Reminders activity, email task capture, Waiting dashboards, and guided weekly reviews.

userStories.title: Add workflow assistant state and settings
userStories.description: As an Uptick user, I want the workflow assistant configured and stored safely so that new features do not expose my private task data.
acceptanceCriteria: Add versioned settings for triage, Waiting follow-ups, activity history, email capture, and weekly review behavior.
Migrate existing Reminders settings without overwriting unrelated configuration.
Store Reminder IDs, Mail locators, learning signals, and activity events only in private local state.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented versioned workflow defaults, non-destructive config merge, and private state; verified with plugin render and workflow fixtures.

userStories.title: Build the triage learning queue
userStories.description: As an Uptick user, I want explainable AI suggestions for uncategorized tasks so that I can approve accurate routing and teach the system my preferences.
acceptanceCriteria: Use the existing Uptick AI provider configuration, including Codex CLI, with explicit preflight and disclosure.
Suggest category, status, duration, phone capability, and priority with confidence and reasons.
Require approval before changing a task; explicit tags remain authoritative.
Persist corrections privately and use them in later recommendations; fall back to local cue inference when unavailable.
Typecheck passes
fixtureCoverage: local cue confidence and tie handling
userStories.notes: Implemented local explainable inference, optional provider preflight, approval, learning, and fallback; verified by workflow fixtures.

userStories.title: Add Waiting follow-up dates
userStories.description: As an Uptick user, I want blocked and dependency tasks to have follow-up dates so that nothing waiting on someone else disappears.
acceptanceCriteria: Represent follow-up date and waiting reason independently from the original due date.
Mirror the follow-up date on the existing Waiting reminder with a configurable follow-up tag.
Treat every Waiting reminder as blocked and pause XP decay.
Restore the task due date when the task leaves Waiting without creating duplicates.
Typecheck passes
fixtureCoverage: Waiting exit restores original due date
userStories.notes: Implemented independent Waiting metadata, follow-up projection, blocked/dependency handling, and due restoration; verified by sync fixtures and live dry-run.

userStories.title: Record reschedule history
userStories.description: As an Uptick user, I want a history of due-date changes so that I can see patterns without losing the task's accountability.
acceptanceCriteria: Record old date, new date, timestamp, source, and optional reason for changes from either system.
Keep history private and out of Reminder Notes and task titles.
Preserve accrued delay and XP decay when rescheduling.
Show reschedule history in task detail and weekly review context.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented private two-source reschedule history, task detail report, and weekly context; verified by workflow fixtures and static checks.

userStories.title: Add the sync activity panel
userStories.description: As an Uptick user, I want an audit view of synchronization so that I can understand what changed and repair failures.
acceptanceCriteria: Record runs, creates, updates, moves, completions, conflicts, skips, and errors in permanent private history.
Provide filters, item links, export, and an explicit clear-history action.
Avoid displaying private IDs and Mail locators by default.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented private activity summaries, filters, redacted export, item detail links, and confirmed clear action; verified by render and workflow checks.

userStories.title: Capture email tasks with subtasks
userStories.description: As an Uptick user, I want selected Mail messages turned into linked parent tasks with approved subtasks so that email commitments become actionable.
acceptanceCriteria: Support imported email-reference notes and selected Apple Mail messages.
Preview extracted actions and let the user approve or edit them before creation.
Create one parent and native Reminders subtasks, mirrored as an Obsidian task hierarchy.
Completing a parent completes all children in both systems; deduplicate by message and action identity.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented imported/selected Mail preview with edit-or-capture approval, Obsidian hierarchy, native child helper, private links, and message/action deduplication.

userStories.title: Build the Waiting dashboard
userStories.description: As an Uptick user, I want a Waiting dashboard so that I can see overdue follow-ups, aging blockers, and next actions in one place.
acceptanceCriteria: Group Waiting tasks by overdue, upcoming, missing date, age, and reason.
Provide confirmed actions for follow up, reschedule, unblock, and archive.
Reflect changes made in Apple Reminders after the next sync.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented Waiting grouping and confirmed follow-up, reschedule, unblock, and archive actions; verified by fixtures and dashboard rendering.

userStories.title: Add the guided weekly review assistant
userStories.description: As an Uptick user, I want a guided weekly review so that I can process triage, overdue work, Waiting follow-ups, and reschedules deliberately.
acceptanceCriteria: Present recommendations for triage, overdue tasks, stale Waiting items, and reschedule patterns.
Require approval for every task change.
Write a concise dated review section without overwriting existing weekly-note content.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented recommendation categories, approval-only controls, and append-only weekly note recording; verified by workflow fixtures and render tests.

userStories.title: Extend the companion and documentation
userStories.description: As an Uptick user, I want the macOS companion and documentation to explain permissions, privacy, and recovery for the full workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Support native Reminders hierarchy, Mail links, and safe structured activity events on macOS.
Keep settings functional on unsupported platforms with an explicit unavailable state.
Document cloud AI data boundaries, Codex/provider configuration, local state, and recovery.
Run existing tests, new fixtures, Python compilation, JavaScript checks, and manual macOS smoke verification.
Typecheck passes
fixtureCoverage: native hierarchy and Mail link helpers
public privacy audit and recovery documentation
userStories.notes: Implemented macOS Reminders/Mail helpers, privacy documentation, and live-safe permission/list smoke; all static, Python, JavaScript, and sync checks pass.

userStories.title: Add sent-email completion settings and private state
userStories.description: As an Uptick user, I want sent-email completion to be configurable and private so that automation is safe and recoverable.
acceptanceCriteria: Add default-off emailCompletion settings for Sent scanning, unique-match auto-completion, lookback, limits, and phrase lists.
Migrate existing workflow settings without changing unrelated configuration.
Store cursors, processed message IDs, completion events, and review candidates only in the private state file.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented default-off emailCompletion settings and private cursor/review state; migration uses the existing config merge.

userStories.title: Scan new sent Apple Mail messages
userStories.description: As an Uptick user, I want new outgoing Mail messages checked during the existing sync so that completed work can be recognized without another scheduler.
acceptanceCriteria: Read only new Sent messages after the private cursor and respect the per-run limit.
Identify messages authored by the configured user account and ignore unavailable Mail permissions safely.
Strip quoted replies and signatures where detectable and never send or modify email.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented Sent-mail AppleScript scanner, cursor/limit handling, quoted-content filtering, and safe permission failure behavior.

userStories.title: Detect explicit completion and match tasks conservatively
userStories.description: As an Uptick user, I want only clear completion statements tied to one task to trigger automation so that replies do not close unrelated work.
acceptanceCriteria: Recognize configurable explicit completion phrases and reject configured negated or future-tense phrases.
Prefer private originating-message/thread associations before normalized-subject fallback.
Allow subject fallback only for one unique open candidate; multiple candidates remain unresolved.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented explicit positive/negative phrase rules, linked association precedence, and unique normalized-subject fallback.

userStories.title: Auto-complete clear matches through two-way sync
userStories.description: As an Uptick user, I want a clear sent completion to close the linked Obsidian task and Reminder in one sync cycle.
acceptanceCriteria: Auto-complete one uniquely linked open task when the explicit completion rule passes.
Propagate the completion to the linked Apple Reminder through the existing sync projection.
Preserve task metadata, due dates, categories, XP history, and reschedule history.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented one-match Obsidian completion before Reminders reconciliation with existing metadata and idempotency preserved.

userStories.title: Add ambiguous email completion review
userStories.description: As an Uptick user, I want uncertain sent-email completion matches reviewed before changing tasks so that automation remains trustworthy.
acceptanceCriteria: Place ambiguous, multi-match, and missing-association signals in a private review queue.
Show safe message summaries, candidate task titles, and match reasons without private Mail IDs.
Require approval to complete a selected candidate and support rejection without changing the task.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented private review queue, candidate selection, approval/rejection controls, and redacted display.

userStories.title: Document and verify sent-email completion
userStories.description: As an Uptick user, I want the sent-email completion behavior documented and testable so that I can understand and recover it.
acceptanceCriteria: Add settings controls for enablement, phrases, lookback, limits, scan status, and review queue access.
Record sent-email scan, detection, approval, rejection, skip, and error activity events.
Document privacy, matching precedence, offline catch-up, cursor recovery, and the lack of Shortcut dependency.
Run Python compilation, JavaScript checks, AppleScript compilation, fixtures, and a live-safe macOS smoke check.
Typecheck passes
fixtureCoverage: public privacy audit and macOS helper smoke
userStories.notes: Implemented settings, activity events, documentation, fixtures, AppleScript compilation, and live-safe macOS smoke verification.

userStories.title: Read new incoming iMessages incrementally
userStories.description: As an Uptick user, I want new incoming iMessages read locally so actionable requests can become tasks without rescanning message history.
acceptanceCriteria: Read Messages through a read-only immutable SQLite connection and persist a private cursor.
Scan incoming direct and group messages while excluding messages sent by the user.
Keep message GUIDs, chat identifiers, sender values, and source associations out of command output and public files.
Handle missing database or Full Disk Access without modifying Messages data.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented immutable incremental reader, private cursor, filtering boundary, fixture support, and safe missing-database handling.

userStories.title: Detect actionable iMessages
userStories.description: As an Uptick user, I want actionable requests detected while ordinary conversation and system messages are ignored.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect request language such as please, can you, need you to, remember to, send, call, schedule, and follow up.
Filter verification codes, reactions, advertisements, URL-only messages, and ordinary acknowledgements.
Run local rules first and optionally use the configured Uptick model only when explicitly enabled.
Create detected actionable tasks automatically without an approval step.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented local action-language and system-message filters with optional configured-provider classification.

userStories.title: Create normalized parent and child tasks
userStories.description: As an Uptick user, I want one iMessage request represented as a clean parent task with child actions in the Task Inbox.
acceptanceCriteria: Write only to the configured canonical Task Inbox.
Create a stable source-derived ID for the parent and each action child.
Extract multiple distinct actions into child tasks and deduplicate repeated actions.
Preserve an explicit YYYY-MM-DD due date and do not invent a date when none exists.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented stable source/action IDs, parent-child Task Inbox output, explicit-date preservation, and idempotency.

userStories.title: Classify iMessage task metadata
userStories.description: As an Uptick user, I want iMessage-created tasks to receive the same category and execution metadata as other Obsidian tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Use explicit category tags first, then configured local cues, then optional model classification.
Route unresolved or tied categories with #needs-triage.
Assign exactly one duration tag, phone capability, not-started status, and low/medium/high priority.
Treat waiting and dependency language as blocked and map highest urgency to high priority plus the Reminder flag.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented category cue precedence, triage fallback, duration/phone/status tags, and priority/flag projection.

userStories.title: Run capture before Reminders reconciliation
userStories.description: As an Uptick user, I want iMessage-created tasks picked up by the existing Reminders automation in the same sync cycle.
acceptanceCriteria: Invoke iMessage task capture before the Reminders bridge reads the Task Inbox.
Reuse the existing 10-minute lock-protected sync path and remain idempotent.
Expose capture counts in the private sync result and activity record.
Continue safely when iMessage access is unavailable and never invoke Shortcuts.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Integrated capture before Reminders reconciliation and removed the obsolete Shortcut hook from the sync wrapper.

userStories.title: Add iMessage capture settings
userStories.description: As an Uptick user, I want to configure iMessage capture without editing files by hand.
acceptanceCriteria: Add enablement, auto-create, model-use, excluded chats, excluded senders, and status controls under Reminders settings.
Show dry-run and status actions with clear unavailable states.
Keep the feature desktop-only and default-off for fresh installations.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added desktop-gated settings controls, status, preview, exclusions, and default-off behavior.

userStories.title: Document privacy and recovery boundaries
userStories.description: As an Uptick user, I want the iMessage capture behavior and recovery controls documented.
acceptanceCriteria: Document the Messages permission requirement, local-first behavior, model opt-in, filters, and automatic creation behavior.
Document that Reminders receives the normal cleaned title, details, tags, dates, priorities, and flags through the existing projection.
Document private cursor/state recovery and the absence of Shortcut requirements.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Updated README and workflow documentation with privacy, recovery, routing, and no-Shortcut boundaries.

userStories.title: Verify iMessage to Reminders flow
userStories.description: As an Uptick maintainer, I want automated coverage proving that iMessage-created tasks follow the Reminders contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Test task creation, hierarchy, deduplication, category routing, tags, due dates, priority, phone capability, and blocked status.
Test the existing Reminders projection and completion behavior using iMessage-origin task fixtures.
Run Python compilation, JavaScript syntax/render tests, shell syntax checks, and a private-vault dry run.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added fixture coverage and completed Python, JavaScript, shell, JSON, diff, and private-vault dry-run verification.
